utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we definitely doing the repair drive today, Mara?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes — I’m still in for it today, and I’ll help get it started.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, I just wanted to make sure. What time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me the date, time, and what kind of repairs the drive is for? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have those details yet, sorry. If you send me the date, time, and repair type, I can help keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No problem — send me the date, time, and repair type when you have them, and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m putting the repair drive details in order now, and I’ll make sure everyone knows where to sign up and what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll stop by late and check the signup sheet. Let me know if you need me to bring anything.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Dane — if you can bring a roll of tape and a marker, that would be a big help. I’ll have the signup sheet ready when you stop by.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting started soon—what do you know about it?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I’ve heard they’re kicking it off soon. If you need tools or a hand, I’m happy to lend both.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s really kind of you, Gus—thank you. I’m still hearing bits and pieces, so I’ll let you know if I need anything.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The back gate sticks the worst, so that’d be first. After that, the loose step by the porch.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll start with the back gate, then check the porch step.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll repeat the repair drive plans to the neighbors and make sure everyone knows what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate that. I’ll keep things organized on my end so we’re ready when everyone shows up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll make sure the neighbors hear the plan and know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Eli, I’m passing the word around for the repair drive—would you be able to lend a hand or stop by?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can stop by and lend a hand. Just let me know what time you need me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great, Eli—thank you! I’ll send you the time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice bit of buzz already — folks seem willing to pitch in. If you want, I can keep an ear out and tell you what’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be mighty kind of you, Tess. I’d appreciate knowing what folks need most so I don’t forget and bring the wrong thing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet — I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if they’re short on anything in particular. So far, I’m hearing it’s the practical stuff folks are leaning toward, but I’ll get you a clearer list soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll work around the school pickup and drop-off times. What time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: It starts at 9, but I’m a bit worried the parking will get tight by then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can get there a little before 9 to help secure a spot. If it’s easier, I can also swing by after drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely. I can stop by and drop off a few things if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That’d be great, thanks—I’m moving fast today, so any drop-off helps. Just leave it by the garage and I’ll sort it later.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, I’ll leave them by the garage on my way back. Glad it’s all coming together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I must've missed the details; what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mostly just tools and spare parts if you have any to share. Even one or two things would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I can probably spare a screwdriver and maybe some screws from the garage. Let me take a quick look and see what else I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Cleo, what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and make sure we’ve got what people need. If you want, I can start a quick list of the missing items.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That would help a lot. I’ll check which items are already covered and send you anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d want to know the timing and where we’re dropping things off first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still waiting on the latest details too, but I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear the drop-off spot and timing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Nell — please do. I’m happy to help once I know the exact timing and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re still sure the repair drive is the right one, Gus?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I’m still sure — it’s the right one to help folks get what they need. I can bring my tools by if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure it’ll fit the system, right? If you want to bring the tools by, I’d want to double-check it first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help if we keep it simple — what time are we meeting for the repair drive, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s meet at 10:00 by the community center entrance, and please bring work gloves and a small flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Got it — 10:00 at the community center entrance. I’ll bring my gloves and a small flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m going to swing by the repair drive and let folks know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s great—people will really appreciate the heads-up. I can spread the word too if you want.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d be perfect, thanks. I’ll keep checking in and repeat the details as they come up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Rosa, the repair drive is this Saturday—everyone’s pitching in, and you’re absolutely welcome to join us. I can send you the details right now!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Quinn — that’d be great. Please send the details, and I’ll see what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send them over right away, and anything you can bring would be wonderful!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mara, I’m a little late—did I miss the repair drive details?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries—you didn’t miss much. I’m still gathering the details, but I can fill you in as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — just let me know when you’ve got them, and I’ll help out where I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I need to keep things low-key today.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me—thank you. I’ll keep it low-key and fit the repair drive around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Faye. I appreciate you working around it—just let me know what needs doing, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Just bring whatever tools you have handy and maybe a few spare screws if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll bring my tools and a few spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep track of what supplies we still need for the repair drive—just tell me what’s been gathered so far.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Appreciate it—I've got a few basics, but I need to check the list again. I'll get back to you with what's still missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good—send me the updated list when you have it, and I’ll note what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam — I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive. What do you need me to coordinate?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — could you help line up a few volunteers and let people know what tools or parts to bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll reach out for a few volunteers and share a simple list of needed tools and parts. If you have any specific items in mind, send them my way and I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is getting organized. Do you need a hand with anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey — I’m a bit mixed up on the details, but I could use help sorting what’s needed and who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I can help make a simple list of the tasks and names, then we can fill in the gaps together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a bit behind on it, but I can help if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah. I’ll check the list and tell you exactly what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Hana. I’ll wait for your list and I’ll do my best to help once I know what’s still missing.
